descriptions.value: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

descriptions.description: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

descriptions.value: Stack-based buffer overflow for some Intel(R) Wireless Bluetooth(R) within Ring 0: Kernel may allow a denial of service. Unprivileged software adversary with an unauthenticated user combined with a low complexity attack may enable denial of service. This result may potentially occur via adjacent access when attack requirements are present without special internal knowledge and requires no user interaction. The potential vulnerability may impact the confidentiality (none), integrity (none) and availability (high) of the vulnerable system, resulting in subsequent system confidentiality (none), integrity (none) and availability (none) impacts.

In multiple functions of bitmap_image_buffer.h, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write on the trusted execution environment heap due to an integer overflow. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In multiple files, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with System execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In ac_get_prot_config of plat_trusty.c, there is a possible memory corruption due to improper input validation. This could lead to local information disclosure with System execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In StNfc_hal_write of hal_st21nfc.cc, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write into global memory due to an incorrect bounds check. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
